method_scope: Independent primal SU2 geometry/edge audit. High wall aspect ratio is not a failure by itself. This does not directly audit SU2 node-centered dual-volume orthogonality; no after-result skew cutoff was introduced.

source.wake_cut: J1 I1..33 paired exactly with I369..337, no wake wall

scope.arm: parent reference-mesh diagnostic; not a new blind prediction or new mesher qualification
not_a_pure_mesh_comparison_to_v2: Published 305-point polygon differs from the r2 interpolated source curve.
Published far boundary is roughly 20-27 chords, not the v2 200c square.
Outer boundary uses the existing SU2 characteristic FARFIELD on all outer edges; WIND uses FREESTREAM plus downstream pressure OUTFLOW.
Wall spacing about 1e-5c is unchanged; strict max y+<1 is not assumed.
scope.purpose: Test native SU2 on a published structured C-grid without experimental fitting; identify whether mesh construction merits targeted investigation.
